scientific_question: At a fixed 16-record pure-endogenous Qwen2.5-7B WebShop training budget, does 4 versus 8 versus 16 task identities change fresh-task transfer under the same validated pooled SD-LoRA route?

upstream_audit.design_implication: No upstream result changes the selected C-D branch. Keep the WebShop runtime pinned and do not represent this pooled comparison as the upstream IID continual protocol.

dataset_selection.required_validation: Reconstruct every selected record from raw reservoir attempts and reject any hash, task, seed, trace, or qualification mismatch before training. Report exact record/identity/trace and token counts for each arm; do not substitute records to balance them.

evaluation.freshness_policy: Exclude all previously committed task identities, all reservoir-v2 train-only identities, and all 64 identities in the aborted pre-protocol reservoir ledger. Build and seal the new evaluation manifest before loading any adapter.

analysis.primary: Each diversity arm minus BASE, task-weighted across complete-valid paired task clusters; 10,000 fixed-seed task-cluster bootstrap CIs and task-level sign-flip tests.
analysis.secondary: Ordered diversity trend across 4/8/16 arms, attempt-weighted ITT-style robustness, parser/fallback taxonomy, and positive/tie/negative task counts.
analysis.interpretation: A monotonic trend supports identity diversity under pooled SD-LoRA only. A null-like result lowers the priority of simple identity-count diversity and elevates the method/content control; neither outcome validates or falsifies the upstream continual protocol.

budget.first_gate: Build all three datasets, validate exact selection hashes, train diversity-4 only, reload it for one 4-seed fresh held-out BASE/diversity-4 task pair, then proceed only if all gate rows are complete-valid.
budget.gpu_policy: Only currently live-idle UUIDs explicitly authorized by the root-first server policy; never preempt, kill, reset, or attribute unresolved external occupancy.

hard_boundaries: No teacher, oracle, SEED, retrieval, or external trajectories.
No record/task replacement, adaptive selection, or additional training/evaluation cells.
No raw reservoir traces committed to Git.
No launch before this config and its code are committed and pushed on the dedicated H1.38A branch.

tracking.offline_fallback: only after a recorded online-probe failure and spool hash
